title: 11 第十一章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

都竞华凭本能直接选择了匿名模式后匆匆**”后，便放心地关闭了页面。

所有人都走在从心流的路上，这十分有利于都竞华将自己隐藏在现有的合法玩家当中。

随后都竞华开始研究自己的新装备。

史诗级道具，紫色品质，除了介绍中存在少量谜语人成分外几乎没有缺点。要不是[森罗万象]无法被外人感知也不能掉落，都竞华怀疑自己刚刚熄灭的跑路打算会被再度点燃。

都竞华的目光先在“种族偏离幅度不得超过5%”上停留了片刻，然后才开始尝试使用。

[森罗万象]来自于[大众脸]。要是介绍里没有夸大其词的部分，[森罗万象]应该可以防止别人发现她的真实信息，而且对方就算看穿此刻的都竞华是虚假的，也无法看到虚假下面的部分。

为了充分掩人耳目，都竞华打算将自己首个伪相设置为合法阵营的人类玩家。

在设置之前，她在论坛中仔细搜索过了一遍。对于合法玩家普遍知晓的常识，其他人固然不会在论坛上特地提起，但也不会刻意去掩饰。

据论坛上流露的只言片语，在进入主城之前，合法玩家与非法玩家的属性成长方式应该没什么区别，甚至连登录方式都很类似，都是在毫无准备的情况下突然参加考核，随后觉醒。不过在参加考核前，很多人都会产生一些特别的感应。

合法玩家考核后取得的成绩高低不一，有些可以称一句优秀，跟都竞华的分数差不多，还有些相对差点，甚至没能及格，可最终所有人都成功登录并加入到了玩家的队伍当中，哪怕在之前的考核中被清空了血条也一样。

初次的考核是安全且无害的，所有怪物似乎只是起到一个氛围组的效果，这跟都竞华的感受迥然不同。

根据论坛上的内容，考核成绩并非判断一个人可不可以登录游戏的标准，能否在现世中遇见游戏副本才是。

了解到这一点后，都竞华就将自己伪相一的玩家等级设置成了二，外表与自己保持一致，种族是人类，阵营为合法玩家，相应的属性也做出了更符合当前等级的调整。

一个刚刚觉醒的萌新。

她激活了唯一的伪相，然后立刻佩戴上面具。

都竞华只觉得皮肤上传来一阵冰凉的触感，紧接着道具就与她融为了一体，除非特意去感受，否则就像空气一样缺乏存在感。

处于绑定状态的[森罗万象]让都竞华感觉到安全与源于灵魂的亲切。

伪相甚至拥有自己的玩家面板，可以过可能是心理方面的缘故，她看着总觉得有些虚幻。

至于道具的第二个额度，都竞华考虑制作一个非人类的伪相。而且如果她猜得没错，介绍中那句“种族偏移”，指的并非是人类与其它普通动物，而是人类与其它智慧生物。

比如《失落大陆》中的森林妖精。

都竞华用自身的意念与[森罗万象]沟通，她可以从道具上感知到某些信息，比如自己越了解一个种族，就越容易创造出相应的伪相。

她尝试直接制作一张森林妖精的伪相，不过很快就失败了。

根据[森罗万象]反馈的信息，森林妖精与人类的种族偏移度绝对高于5%。都竞华依照提醒做出调整，最终的成品是一个人类与森林妖精的混血伪相。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Du Jinghua instinctively selected the anonymous mode and hurriedly closed the page with confidence.

Everyone is on the road of flow, which is very conducive to Du Jinghua hiding himself among the existing legal players.

Then Du Jinghua began to study his new equipment.

Epic props, purple quality, almost no shortcomings except for a small amount of Riddler elements in the introduction.If [Sen Luo Wan Xiang] hadn't been able to be sensed by outsiders and couldn't be dropped, Du Jinghua suspected that his newly extinguished escape plan would be rekindled.

Du Jinghua's eyes first stayed on "the racial deviation shall not exceed 5%" for a moment, and then he started to try to use it.

[Sen Luo Wan Xiang] comes from [Public Face].If there is no exaggeration in the introduction, [Sen Luo Wan Xiang] should be able to prevent others from discovering her true information, and even if the other party sees through that Du Jinghua is false at this moment, they will not be able to see the part below the falsehood.

In order to completely hide his identity from others, Du Jinghua planned to set up his first disguise as a human player of the legal camp.

Before setting it up, she searched the forum carefully.Although others will not specifically mention common knowledge among legitimate players on the forum, they will not deliberately cover it up either.

According to a few words leaked on the forum, before entering the main city, there should be no difference between the attribute growth methods of legal players and illegal players. Even the login methods are very similar. They all suddenly participate in the assessment without preparation and then awaken.However, before taking the assessment, many people will have some special feelings.

The scores obtained by legal players after the assessment vary. Some can be called excellent, similar to Du Jinghua's score, and some are relatively poor, or even failed. But in the end, all of them successfully logged in and joined the player's team, even if their health bars were cleared in the previous assessment.

The first assessment was safe and harmless. All the monsters seemed to just serve as an atmosphere group, which was completely different from Du Jinghua's feelings.

According to the content on the forum, the assessment score is not the criterion for judging whether a person can log into the game, but whether he can meet a copy of the game in the real world.

After understanding this, Du Jinghua set his pseudo-1 player level to level 2. His appearance was consistent with his own, his race was human, his camp was a legal player, and the corresponding attributes were adjusted to be more in line with the current level.

A newbie who has just awakened.

She activated her single semblance and immediately donned the mask.

Du Jinghua only felt a cold touch on her skin, and then the prop became one with her. Unless she felt it specifically, it would be as lacking in existence as air.

The bound state of [Sen Luo Wan Xiang] made Du Jinghua feel safe and kind from the soul.

She even has her own player board, which she can play. Maybe it's for psychological reasons, but she always feels a little illusory when she looks at it.

As for the second amount of props, Du Jinghua considered making a non-human illusion.And if she guessed correctly, the phrase "racial deviation" in the introduction did not refer to humans and other ordinary animals, but humans and other intelligent creatures.

For example, the forest goblin in "The Lost Continent".

Du Jinghua uses her own thoughts to communicate with [Sen Luo Wan Xiang], and she can perceive certain information from the props. For example, the better she understands a race, the easier it is to create the corresponding illusion.

She tried to directly create a fake image of a forest elf, but it quickly failed.

According to the feedback from [Sen Luo Wan Xiang], the racial deviation between forest elves and humans is definitely higher than 5%.Du Jinghua made adjustments according to the reminder, and the final product was a fake hybrid of a human and a forest elf.
